System design & behavioural · Microfrontends

When would you choose Microfrontends over a monolithic frontend?

Answer

Choose micro-frontends when:

  • Multiple teams work on a large product and need independent release cycles.
  • Domains are clearly separable (checkout, search, profile).
  • You need incremental migration of a legacy app or mixed frameworks.
  • Different parts scale or change at very different rates.

Stay with a (well-modularized) monolith when the team is small, the app is medium-sized, or features are tightly coupled — micro-frontends add infra, versioning and performance overhead that's not worth it there.
